evidence: Tagged with Wallet label and modifies `src/wallet/rpc/encrypt.cpp` along with numerous wallet tests.
rationale: Deprecating post-creation wallet encryption addresses serious fund safety and backup footguns. Encrypting existing wallets leaves plaintext keys on disk, invalidates previous backups risking loss of funds, and 'will cause the wallet to change the spending conditions out from under the user' on imported descriptors (#26607).
